---
title: "ssoossh ca"
description: "Print the CA public key of the configured ssoossh server."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Prints the public key of the server's certificate authority in authorized_keys format, one key per line (two while a CA rotation is under way). Hosts that accept ssoossh certificates name this file in sshd's TrustedUserCAKeys.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh ca
```

## Examples

```bash
# Trust ssoossh certificates on an sshd host
  ssoossh ca | sudo tee /etc/ssh/ssoossh_ca.pub
  # then, in sshd_config: TrustedUserCAKeys /etc/ssh/ssoossh_ca.pub
```
